claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.found_only_on_target
claims.statement:
∀ (task task' : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeTask) (id : String) (time : Nat) (r : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeRecord),
  Swf.AppChallenge.challengeStep task (Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent.selected id time) =
      Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeAnswer.next task' (some r) →
    ∃ run,
      task.run = some run ∧
        id = run.target ∧
          run.startedAt ≤ time ∧
            r = { target := run.target, method := run.method, ms := time - run.startedAt, actions := run.actions } ∧
              task' = { run := none, records := task.records.push r }

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.names_one_when_any
claims.statement:
∀ (candidates : Array Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate) (selected : Option String) (draw : Nat)
  (c : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate),
  c ∈ candidates → some c.id ≠ selected → (Swf.AppChallenge.challengeTarget candidates selected draw).isSome = true

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.other_selection_changes_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (task : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeTask) (id : String) (time : Nat),
  (∀ (r : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeRun), task.run = some r → id ≠ r.target) →
    Swf.AppChallenge.challengeStep task (Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent.selected id time) =
      Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeAnswer.next task none

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.prefers_behind
claims.statement:
∀ (candidates : Array Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate) (selected : Option String) (draw : Nat)
  (b : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate),
  b ∈ candidates →
    b.behind = true →
      some b.id ≠ selected →
        ∃ c, c ∈ candidates ∧ Swf.AppChallenge.challengeTarget candidates selected draw = some c.id ∧ c.behind = true

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.records_only_grow
claims.statement:
∀ (task task' : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeTask) (e : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent)
  (found : Option Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeRecord),
  e ≠ Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent.clear →
    ∀ (h : Swf.AppChallenge.challengeStep task e = Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeAnswer.next task' found),
      task'.records =
        match found, h with
        | none, h => task.records
        | some r, h => task.records.push r

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.target_is_an_unselected_candidate
claims.statement:
∀ (candidates : Array Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate) (selected : Option String) (draw : Nat) (id : String),
  Swf.AppChallenge.challengeTarget candidates selected draw = some id →
    ∃ c, c ∈ candidates ∧ c.id = id ∧ some id ≠ selected

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.detach_needs_two_surfaces
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf w created label : String)
  (parentId : Option String) (kept : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.detach r) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.detach sf w created label parentId kept →
    ∃ n,
      s.window? (some w) = some n ∧
        2 ≤ n.surfaceIds.size ∧
          kept = Array.filter (fun x => x != sf) n.surfaceIds ∧ parentId = n.parentId ∧ ¬created ∈ s.ids

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.emptied_group_removed_only
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (t : Swf.AppComposition.CompTarget) (w : String)
  (into : Swf.AppComposition.CompInto) (g : String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.regroup r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.regroup w into (some g) →
    ∃ n left,
      s.window? r.id = some n ∧
        n.parentId.bind s.node? = some left ∧
          left.id = g ∧
            left.kind = "group" ∧
              s.orbitRootId ≠ some g ∧
                left.childIds.size = 1 ∧ left.surfaceIds.size = 0 ∧ ∃ id, t = Swf.AppComposition.CompTarget.group id

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.emptying_refused_alike
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf : Swf.AppComposition.CompSurface)
  (source : Swf.AppComposition.CompNode),
  r.id.bind s.surface? = some sf →
    s.window? (some sf.owner) = some source →
      (∃ target, s.window? t.id = some target ∧ target.id ≠ sf.owner) →
        (Array.filter (fun x => x != sf.id) source.surfaceIds).size = 0 →
          source.childIds.size > 0 →
            Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.move r t) =
                Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.refused "surfaceId" (Swf.AppComposition.holdsNodes source) ∧
              ∀ (t' : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (target' : Swf.AppComposition.CompNode),
                s.window? t'.id = some target' →
                  target'.id ≠ source.id →
                    Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s
                        (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.merge { id := some source.id, shown := source.id } t') =
                      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.refused "windowId" (Swf.AppComposition.holdsNodes source)

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.free_id_prefers_stem
claims.statement: ∀ (taken : Array String) (stem : String), ¬stem ∈ taken → Swf.AppComposition.compositionFreeId taken stem = stem

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.free_id_unused
claims.statement: ∀ (taken : Array String) (stem : String), ¬Swf.AppComposition.compositionFreeId taken stem ∈ taken

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.merge_keeps_every_surface
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (source target : String)
  (moved laidOut : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.merge r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.merge source target moved laidOut →
    ∃ ns nt,
      s.window? r.id = some ns ∧
        s.window? t.id = some nt ∧
          ns.id = source ∧
            nt.id = target ∧
              source ≠ target ∧ ns.childIds.size = 0 ∧ moved = ns.surfaceIds ∧ laidOut = nt.surfaceIds ++ ns.surfaceIds

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.move_keeps_every_surface
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf target source : String)
  (laidOut left : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.move r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.move sf target laidOut source left →
    ∃ nt ns,
      s.window? t.id = some nt ∧
        s.window? (some source) = some ns ∧
          nt.id = target ∧
            ns.id = source ∧
              target ≠ source ∧
                laidOut = nt.surfaceIds.push sf ∧
                  left = Array.filter (fun x => x != sf) ns.surfaceIds ∧ (left.size = 0 → ns.childIds.size = 0)

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.regroup_into_other_group
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (t : Swf.AppComposition.CompTarget) (w : String)
  (into : Swf.AppComposition.CompInto) (removed : Option String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.regroup r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.regroup w into removed →
    ∃ n,
      s.window? r.id = some n ∧
        n.id = w ∧
          ((∃ g,
              into = Swf.AppComposition.CompInto.group g.id ∧
                s.node? g.id = some g ∧ g.kind = "group" ∧ g.active = true ∧ n.parentId ≠ some g.id) ∨
            ∃ id label, into = Swf.AppComposition.CompInto.fresh id label n.parentId ∧ ¬id ∈ s.ids)

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.window_with_nodes_never_emptied
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (w : Swf.AppComposition.CompNode),
  s.window? (some w.id) = some w →
    w.childIds.size > 0 →
      (∀ (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf target : String) (laidOut left : Array String),
          Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.move r t) =
              Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.move sf target laidOut w.id left →
            left.size ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (target : String) (moved laidOut : Array String),
          Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.merge r t) ≠
            Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.merge w.id target moved laidOut

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.cursor_only_while_moving
claims.statement:
∀ (taken : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (x width y : Float) (wraps : Bool),
  Swf.AppCursor.wrapPointerStep taken key phase x width wraps = Swf.AppCursor.WrapOutcome.wrapped y true →
    phase = Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.move

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.invalid_width_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (taken : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (x width : Float) (wraps : Bool),
  (!decide (width > 0) || !width.isFinite) = true →
    Swf.AppCursor.wrapPointerStep taken key phase x width wraps = Swf.AppCursor.WrapOutcome.invalidWidth

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.nonfinite_x_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (taken : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (x width : Float) (wraps : Bool),
  (!decide (width > 0) || !width.isFinite) = false →
    (Swf.AppCursor.wrapPointerStep taken key phase x width wraps = Swf.AppCursor.WrapOutcome.invalidX ↔
      x.isFinite = false)

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.released_on_up_or_cancel
claims.statement:
∀ (taken : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (consumed : Bool),
  phase = Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.up ∨ phase = Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.cancel →
    key ∈ taken →
      ∃ taken',
        Swf.AppCursor.wrapAfterDispatch taken key phase consumed = some taken' ∧
          ¬key ∈ taken' ∧ ∀ (k : String), k ∈ taken → k ≠ key → k ∈ taken'

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.taken_only_on_consumed_down
claims.statement:
∀ (taken taken' : List String) (key k : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (consumed : Bool),
  Swf.AppCursor.wrapAfterDispatch taken key phase consumed = some taken' →
    k ∈ taken' → ¬k ∈ taken → phase = Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.down ∧ consumed = true ∧ k = key

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.taken_stays_distinct
claims.statement:
∀ (taken taken' : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (consumed : Bool),
  taken.Nodup → Swf.AppCursor.wrapAfterDispatch taken key phase consumed = some taken' → taken'.Nodup

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.untaken_passes_unchanged
claims.statement:
∀ (taken : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (x width : Float) (wraps : Bool),
  ¬key ∈ taken →
    Swf.AppCursor.wrapPointerStep taken key phase x width wraps = Swf.AppCursor.WrapOutcome.pass ∨
      Swf.AppCursor.wrapPointerStep taken key phase x width wraps = Swf.AppCursor.WrapOutcome.invalidWidth ∨
        Swf.AppCursor.wrapPointerStep taken key phase x width wraps = Swf.AppCursor.WrapOutcome.invalidX

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.wraps_only_held_pointers_in_wrapping_views
claims.statement:
∀ (taken : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (x width y : Float) (wraps cursor : Bool),
  Swf.AppCursor.wrapPointerStep taken key phase x width wraps = Swf.AppCursor.WrapOutcome.wrapped y cursor →
    wraps = true ∧ phase ≠ Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.down ∧ key ∈ taken ∧ x.isFinite = true

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.band_by_thresholds
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (out : Array Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.bands out →
    ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < q.distances.size),
      q.focused ≠ some i →
        ∃ hi',
          (out[i] = Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand.full ↔ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i] < Swf.Order.floatKey q.bands.full) ∧
            (out[i] = Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand.label ↔
              Swf.Order.floatKey q.bands.full ≤ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i] ∧
                Swf.Order.floatKey q.bands.compact ≤ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i])

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.focused_full
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (out : Array Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.bands out →
    ∀ (i : Nat), i < q.distances.size → q.focused = some i → ∃ hi', out[i] = Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand.full

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.invalid_bands_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery),
  (q.bands.full.isNaN || q.bands.compact.isNaN) = true →
    Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.invalidBands

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.invalid_distance_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (i : Nat),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.invalidDistance i →
    i < q.distances.size ∧ Swf.AppDepth.distanceOk q.distances[i]! = false

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.monotone
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (out : Array Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.bands out →
    ∀ (i j : Nat) (hi : i < q.distances.size) (hj : j < q.distances.size),
      q.focused ≠ some i →
        q.focused ≠ some j →
          Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i] ≤ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[j] → ∃ hi' hj', out[j].shown ≤ out[i].shown

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.one_band_per_window

claims.name: Swf.AppFeatures.accepted_settings_valid
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureSettings) (patch : Swf.Json) (e : Option Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureFlags)
  (s : Option Swf.AppFeatures.SnapSettings) (d : Option Swf.AppFeatures.DepthBands),
  current.snap.valid = true →
    current.depth.valid = true →
      Swf.AppFeatures.featuresUpdate current patch = Swf.AppFeatures.FeaturesUpdate.updated e s d →

claims.name: Swf.AppFeatures.changed_parts_differ
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureSettings) (patch : Swf.Json) (e : Option Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureFlags)
  (s : Option Swf.AppFeatures.SnapSettings) (d : Option Swf.AppFeatures.DepthBands),
  Swf.AppFeatures.featuresUpdate current patch = Swf.AppFeatures.FeaturesUpdate.updated e s d →
    (∀ (f : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureFlags), e = some f → f ≠ current.enabled) ∧
      (∀ (x : Swf.AppFeatures.SnapSettings), s = some x → x.same current.snap = false) ∧
        ∀ (x : Swf.AppFeatures.DepthBands), d = some x → x.same current.depth = false

∀ (current : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureSettings),

claims.name: Swf.AppFeatures.not_object_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureSettings) (patch : Swf.Json),
  (∀ (ms : Array (String × Swf.Json)), patch ≠ Swf.Json.obj ms) →
    Swf.AppFeatures.featuresUpdate current patch =
      Swf.AppFeatures.FeaturesUpdate.refused "features" Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureFault.notObject

claims.name: Swf.AppFeatures.refused_patch_atomic
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureSettings) (ms : Array (String × Swf.Json)) (e : Option Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureFlags)
  (s : Option Swf.AppFeatures.SnapSettings) (d : Option Swf.AppFeatures.DepthBands),
  Swf.AppFeatures.featuresUpdate current (Swf.Json.obj ms) = Swf.AppFeatures.FeaturesUpdate.updated e s d →
    (∀ (v : Swf.Json),
        Swf.AppFeatures.member ms "enabled" = some v →
          ∃ f, Swf.AppFeatures.flagsCheck current.enabled v = Except.ok f) ∧
      (∀ (v : Swf.Json),
          Swf.AppFeatures.member ms "snap" = some v → ∃ x, Swf.AppFeatures.snapCheck current.snap v = Except.ok x) ∧
        ∀ (v : Swf.Json),
          Swf.AppFeatures.member ms "depth" = some v → ∃ x, Swf.AppFeatures.depthCheck current.depth v = Except.ok x

claims.name: Swf.AppFeatures.unknown_field_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureSettings) (ms : Array (String × Swf.Json)) (m : String × Swf.Json),
  Array.find? (fun m => !Swf.AppFeatures.patchKeys.contains m.fst) ms = some m →
    Swf.AppFeatures.featuresUpdate current (Swf.Json.obj ms) =
      Swf.AppFeatures.FeaturesUpdate.refused ("features" ++ "." ++ m.fst)
        (Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureFault.unknown Swf.AppFeatures.patchKeys)

claims.name: Swf.AppScenarios.step_done_only_when_it_holds

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.occluded_by_nearer

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.settled_state

∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.Settlement),

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.settles_truthfully
claims.statement:
∀ (attempt : Swf.Handoff.Attempt) (oldUsable : Bool),
  (Swf.Handoff.settle attempt oldUsable = Swf.Handoff.Settlement.degraded ↔
      attempt ≠ Swf.Handoff.Attempt.worked ∧ oldUsable = false) ∧

          attempt = Swf.Handoff.Attempt.failed restored ∧ oldUsable = true) ∧

          oldUsable = true → Swf.Handoff.settle attempt oldUsable = Swf.Handoff.Settlement.switched) ∧

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.stage_order
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.ViewportState) (e : Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent),

      s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.preparing ∧ e = Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent.prepared) ∧
    (Swf.Handoff.handoffStep s e = some Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.swapping →
        s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.validating ∧ e = Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent.validated) ∧
      (Swf.Handoff.handoffStep s e = some Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.active →

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.admits_iff_ready

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_advances_revision

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_bounded
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (c : Swf.Kernel.Change),

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_history
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (c : Swf.Kernel.Change),
  have r := Swf.Kernel.commit l c;
  (r.clearRedo = true → r.next.redo = 0) ∧
    (r.clearRedo = false → r.next.undo = l.undo ∧ r.next.redo = l.redo ∧ r.push = false ∧ r.dropOldest = false)

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_mirrors_records
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (layout keyed : Bool) (s : Nat),
  (have r := Swf.Kernel.commit l (Swf.Kernel.Change.commands layout keyed);
    ((r.next.undo + if r.dropOldest = true then 1 else 0) = l.undo + if r.push = true then 1 else 0) ∧
      (r.next.redo = if r.clearRedo = true then 0 else l.redo) ∧
        r.next.keys + r.evictKeys = l.keys + if keyed = true then 1 else 0) ∧
    have r := Swf.Kernel.commit l (Swf.Kernel.Change.restore layout s);
    ((r.next.undo + if r.dropOldest = true then 1 else 0) = l.undo + if r.push = true then 1 else 0) ∧
      (r.next.redo = if r.clearRedo = true then 0 else l.redo) ∧ r.next.keys = l.keys ∧ r.evictKeys = 0

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.delivers_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle), Swf.Kernel.delivers l = true ↔ l ≠ Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposed

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.dispose_order
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger),
  l.lifecycle = Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.ready →
    Swf.Kernel.idle l = Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.rest ∧
      Swf.Kernel.idle (Swf.Kernel.dispose l) =
          Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.announce
            { lifecycle := Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposing true, revision := l.revision, undo := l.undo, redo := l.redo,
              undoCapacity := l.undoCapacity, keys := l.keys, keyCapacity := l.keyCapacity } ∧
        Swf.Kernel.idle
            { lifecycle := Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposing true, revision := l.revision, undo := l.undo, redo := l.redo,
              undoCapacity := l.undoCapacity, keys := l.keys, keyCapacity := l.keyCapacity } =
          Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.finish
            { lifecycle := Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposed, revision := l.revision, undo := 0, redo := 0,
              undoCapacity := l.undoCapacity, keys := 0, keyCapacity := l.keyCapacity }

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.disposed_absorbing
claims.statement:

      Swf.Kernel.dispose l = l ∧
        Swf.Kernel.idle l = Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.rest ∧

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.gate_order

        Swf.Kernel.gate l { known := some false, expected := e } = Swf.Kernel.TxGate.refuseKeyReused ∧
          (Swf.Kernel.gate l { known := none, expected := e } = Swf.Kernel.TxGate.proceed ↔

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.initial_bounded

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.not_ready_refuses

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.travel_moves_one
claims.statement:
